rules: Never use an image discovered through a generic Google Images search.
Never assume an image is free because a search result displays it.
Store source URL and license metadata for every external image.
Reject external images when license information cannot be verified.
Every article must have an article-specific image before publication.
The image prompt or renderer must be derived from the article title, description, and category; never select a random stock image.
Prefer original AI-generated visuals when a suitable AI image provider is configured.
Use TrendForge original topic visuals as the free fallback when no AI image provider is configured.
